summary: A 59 EUR first-90-days Notion kit for new French mandataires, sold by network sponsors to their recruits for a 30% cut

competitors.name: Notion: CRM for real estate agents (free)

recommended.why: Inside the 19-89 one-off range. At 59 EUR TTC about 45.75 EUR is kept after VAT and Lemon Squeezy 5% + 0.50 USD; a 30% sponsor cut (14.75) still leaves LTV:CAC 3.1

must.why: The 19 EUR French template needs 20-40 minutes of manual columns and relations after import
The closest French rival lists prospecting planning as 'a venir' (not built)

must.feature: Leads, visits and mandates linked to owner and buyer
must.why: The core job every rival covers; missing it fails the comparison

must.feature: First-90-days playbook: call scripts and a daily routine
must.why: 75% of 2024 recruits in mandataire networks had never worked in real estate

cut.why: Cannot be sold as Hoguet-compliant; the network holds the register
Notion cannot push to portals; Hektor and Apimo already do it
Wait for 50 French sales first; BE is a quarter of the market and needs a translation

differentiator.feature: Sponsor view: the parrain sees each recruit's weekly calls, estimates and mandates
differentiator.why: Networks already coach recruits monthly; this gives the sponsor numbers for that meeting and a reason to push the kit

levers.change: Sell through iad/SAFTI/Capifrance sponsors and team leaders with a 30% affiliate link, paid only on sale
levers.evidence: Mandataire networks grow by recruiting and sponsoring, and 75% of 2024 recruits were new to real estate; commission-only CAC is 14.75 EUR against 45.75 EUR kept

moves.why: CAC becomes the commission: 45.75 / 14.75 = 3.1, inside the 2-3 anchor
A channel with a known cost exists, but no sponsor has agreed yet

prerequisites.what: At least 2 sponsors with 10+ recruits each who agree to share the link
A merchant-of-record shop with affiliate links (Lemon Squeezy)

levers.change: Turn the 39 EUR template pack into a 59 EUR first-90-days kit: one-click tracker, pige planner, call scripts, sponsor view
levers.evidence: French rivals sell 19-89 EUR; the 19 EUR one needs 20-40 min of manual setup and the 89 EUR one has not shipped its prospecting planner

moves.why: A method for beginners is priced against coaching, not against the 19 EUR template
Free covers the tracker but not the routine and scripts; the free_alternative hit stays
One specific difference (sponsor view plus beginner routine), easy to copy
More content to write: 4-6 weeks instead of 1-2
Full kit later; a pre-sale page still ships in 2 weeks

prerequisites.what: Interviews with 5 mandataires in their first year

levers.change: Co-author the scripts and routine with one working mandataire, ideally the first sponsor, for a revenue share
levers.evidence: The verdict scored skills and assets low for no real-estate know-how and no network; one insider fixes part of both

moves.why: The co-author brings pige, mandate and compromis know-how
Domain gap covered by a partner, founder still without a track record
A partner with a team is one asset, not yet secured

prerequisites.what: One mandataire with 3+ years in a network willing to co-author

gross_margin.note: About 28.6 EUR kept of 39 EUR after VAT and Notion's 8% + 0.40 USD + 1% FX: 73% margin

ltv_cac.note: Sponsor sales: LTV 45.75 EUR vs 30% commission 14.75 EUR = 3.1 (projected, excludes founder outreach hours)

pricing_power.note: 59 EUR kit with a 90-day method escapes the 19 EUR template anchor; free Notion CRM still caps it

build_effort.note: Tracker plus playbook and scripts: 4-6 weeks at 5 h/week instead of 1-2

skills_match.note: A working mandataire co-designs the pige routine and scripts; Notion skills learnable

capital_needed.note: Gumroad and Notion Marketplace charge no monthly fee; 100 EUR covers it

time_to_mvp.note: Pre-sale in 2 weeks, full kit in 4-6 weeks

sales_cycle.note: 39 EUR is an impulse buy for an individual agent, no committee

channel_readiness.note: Sponsors push to recruits for a 30% cut, paid only on sale; no sponsor signed yet

search_demand.note: 44,000 mandataires in France (end 2024) but no measured search volume for Notion real-estate templates

trend.note: Mandataire count fell 5% in 2024; only 4 of the top 10 networks still growing in H1 2026 (R5: max 2.5)

willingness_to_pay.note: Agents already pay 159-200 EUR/month network packs that bundle tools; templates sell at 7-45 USD

free_alternatives.note: Free Notion CRM covers the tracker, not a 90-day prospecting routine for beginners

competitor_density.note: 20+ paid Notion real-estate templates, 3+ in French, plus Hektor at 8,500 agencies

differentiation.note: One real difference: sponsor view of recruits' weekly prospecting plus a beginner routine; copyable

legal_regulatory.note: Cannot be sold as a Hoguet-compliant registre des mandats; prospect data sits in the US outside Enterprise

platform_dependency.note: 100% Notion-dependent; Marketplace lists in USD only and Notion may revise fees at any time

market_risk.note: Real estate is cyclical: 1,120 agency failures May 2023-Apr 2024, rebound in 2025

skills.note: Domain gap covered by a mandataire co-author; founder still has no track record

assets.note: One sponsor partner with a team would be the only asset; none signed yet

interest.note: Stated goal is side income, no domain passion

rules_applied.effect: free_alternative hit: free_alternatives 2 <= 2; weak_demand: trend 2 <= 2.5; legal_platform_risk: min 2.5 <= 2.5; strong_competitor: density 1.5 <= 3

blockers: A free Notion CRM and 20+ paid templates keep Competitive room at 2.0 whatever the kit adds
Mandataire numbers fell 5% in 2024 and no search volume is measured: Demand stays at 2.2
Networks bundle tools and coaches into 159-200 EUR/month packs, so willingness to pay a third party stays low
Founder fit: no domain know-how, no audience and a money-only motive; a partner covers only part of it
Even a fully proven sponsor channel (channel_readiness 5) adds 2.5 points: the ceiling is about 63

plan.step: Interview 5 mandataires in their first year about how they track leads and pige
plan.verify: 3 of 5 name follow-up or pige as a weekly pain

plan.step: Message 30 iad, SAFTI and Capifrance team leaders offering the 30% link and a free sponsor view
Pre-sale page at 59 EUR on Lemon Squeezy with affiliate links, shared by the sponsors
Build the kit with the co-author and deliver it to pre-buyers
plan.verify: 4 of 5 buyers log 10+ leads in their first week

plan.step: Add sponsors from buyers' networks; track sales per sponsor
plan.verify: 16 sales a month = 500 EUR net side income

kill_criteria: Fewer than 2 sponsors agree by 2026-11-25 -> archive
Fewer than 5 paid pre-orders at 59 EUR by 2026-12-09 -> archive
Fewer than 10 sales a month by 2027-02-28 -> stop building, keep it as a passive listing
